history.name: alpaca_us_etfs_daily_sip_v1
history.entitlement: Alpaca market-data API with the owner's free account keys. Historical SIP bars (consolidated, all US exchanges) need no subscription when the request's end is at least 15 minutes old (Alpaca Market Data FAQ); this dataset ends 2026-11-01. Keys are read at run time from the OS keyring (trader secrets) or session environment variables; never stored in the repository.
history.availability_rule: One bar per XNYS regular session, [session open, session close) in UTC with early closes from the exchange calendar; usable at the close + 1 s, so a decision on a completed day fills at the next session's open. Open, high, low and close are regular-session prices (Alpaca's daily bars exclude extended-hours trades from them); volume, trade count and VWAP also count pre-market and after-hours trades and are final only 4 h after the close.
history.corrections: Raw (unadjusted) prices; splits and symbol changes come from the corporate-actions endpoint and are applied point-in-time in research. Cash distributions are neither adjusted for nor credited: an ex-distribution drop appears as a price move, so a position held across an ex-date understates total return (conservative for long-only rules) and indicators see the drop.

quality.gap_semantics: One bar per XNYS regular session is expected; Alpaca emits no daily bar for a session without qualifying trades, so a missing session is reported and never filled. Daily open, high, low and close are regular-session prices; volume, trade count and VWAP also count pre-market and after-hours trades.

history.notes: Fixed 16-ETF universe (US equity index, sector, Treasury and gold funds) chosen for daily rule research before any strategy was evaluated on it. It is today's list of long-lived liquid funds, so survivorship is disclosed, not corrected. ETFs are research instruments: markets_and_brokers.md section 7 notes European retail restrictions on US ETFs, and the v1 STOCKS profile trades ordinary shares only (product type ETF is rejected there). SIP volume is consolidated and must never be compared with the IEX volume of alpaca_us_equities_5m_v1.

history.name: coinbase_btc_eth_usd_daily_v1
history.entitlement: Coinbase Exchange public market-data REST endpoint (no account, no key, no fee). Research use only; data is not redistributed (files stay out of git). Coinbase market-data terms apply.
history.availability_rule: One bar per UTC day, [00:00, 24:00) UTC: Coinbase granularity 86400 s, each bucket stamped at its day's 00:00 UTC, stored as a fixed 1440-minute interval on the UTC_24_7 calendar (every UTC day has the same length, so no session table is needed). A bar is usable at its end + 1 s (00:00:01 UTC of the next day), so a decision on a completed day fills at the next day's open under the research fill model. Candles still in progress at retrieval are excluded.
history.corrections: Overlapping pages must agree exactly; a conflicting duplicate aborts ingestion. No revision history is available from the source.

quality.gap_semantics: Coinbase omits buckets without trades, so a missing bucket is either an outage or an interval without trades; research treats it as missing data (fail closed).
Coinbase omits buckets without trades, so a missing bucket is either an outage or an interval without trades; research treats it as missing data (fail closed).

history.notes: Daily price proxy for Kraken BTC/USD and ETH/USD in crypto_daily_v1 (ADR-0018, ADR-0041). Both pairs are requested from 2016-01-01; days before a pair's first Coinbase candle count as missing intervals in its quality report. The venue basis against Kraken is measured on the recent 15-minute week (coinbase_btc_eth_usd_15m_recent_v1 vs kraken_btc_eth_usd_15m_recent_v1).

history.name: capital_demo_cfd_1d_v1
history.entitlement: Capital.com DEMO account API, read with the owner's demo keys (free; no live account is involved). Research use only; data is not redistributed (files stay out of git). Capital.com's API terms apply.
history.availability_rule: One bar per UTC day [00:00, 24:00) on which the market quoted, stamped at 00:00 UTC and stored as a fixed 1440-minute interval; each side (bid, ask) is its own file with the same bar starts. The daily bar ends two to three hours after the New York close. A market that opens on Sunday evening has a short Sunday bar, which a study joins to Monday's (data/quote_bars.py). A bar is usable at its end + 1 s. Candles still forming at retrieval are excluded.
history.corrections: Pages are walked backwards, each ending one second before the oldest bar of the page above; a conflicting duplicate aborts ingestion. The source keeps no revision history. Whether it recomputes old candles is checked by acquiring twice on different days (ADR-0052): if the content checksums differ the dataset is marked not restorable.

quality.gap_semantics: The bars that exist are the record of when the market was open: a closed market (nights, weekends, holidays) and an hour without a quote both leave no bar, and the source does not distinguish them. No expected grid is built, so coverage is reported as 0 by construction.

quotes.volume: the source's tick count per bar, not traded volume

history.name: capital_demo_crypto_cfd_1h_v1
history.entitlement: Capital.com DEMO account API, read with the owner's demo keys (free; no live account is involved). Research use only; data is not redistributed (files stay out of git). Capital.com's API terms apply.
history.availability_rule: One bar per hour on the UTC clock grid while the market quoted; each side (bid, ask) is its own file with the same bar starts. A bar is usable at its end + 1 s. Candles still forming at retrieval are excluded.
history.corrections: Pages are walked backwards, each ending one second before the oldest bar of the page above; a conflicting duplicate aborts ingestion. The source keeps no revision history. Whether it recomputes old candles is checked by acquiring twice on different days (ADR-0052): if the content checksums differ the dataset is marked not restorable.
